# Brimstone

Internal ID: TrinketFlametalStaminaHealth | Type: Trinkets | Source: Black forge | Crafting Materials: Flametal x5, Sulfur x5, Molten core x1, Morgen trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 100 | Effect: 100 health gain | 100 stamina gain

# Introduction

Brimstone is an Ashlands-tier trinket.

## Effects

Once 100 Adrenaline has been gained, the Brimstone will trigger automatically, providing 100 health and 100 stamina immediately.

Categorias: Trinket
